title: National Greek Exam
text: The National Greek Exam, hosted by the esteemed American Classical League, presents an exceptional opportunity for high school students to demonstrate their proficiency in Ancient Greek. This prestigious exam encourages students to cultivate an in-depth understanding of the language's nuances and immerse themselves in its rich history and cultural significance. Participation in the National Greek Exam not only tests students' skills but also fosters their appreciation for the language and its enduring influence on Western civilization.

title: National Italian Exam
text: The National Italian Exam (NIE) evaluates high school students' Italian language proficiency through written and aural interpretation assessments. Its rigorous standards align with ACTFL Performance Descriptors and Proficiency Guidelines. Top-performing students earn esteemed prizes, including monetary awards, study trips to Italy, medals, and certificates. Participating in the NIE allows students to showcase their Italian language skills, gain recognition for their achievements, and potentially expand their future opportunities.

title: National Japan Bowl
text: This highly-regarded competition offers participants an opportunity to showcase and expand their Japanese language skills. High school students can benefit greatly from participating in the Japan Bowl by developing confidence in their language abilities, enhancing their understanding of Japanese culture, and broadening their global perspective. The competition encourages teamwork, reinforces critical thinking, and fosters camaraderie among students with shared interests. By immersing themselves in this competitive environment, participants can gain invaluable experience that can serve them well in their future academic and professional endeavors.

title: National Latin Exam
text: The National Latin Exam (NLE) presents a magnificent opportunity for high school Latin students to showcase their skills and earn recognition for their academic achievements. This annual test provides students with an avenue to reinforce their classroom learning while potentially qualifying for scholarships. Participants can strive to achieve certificates, medals, and scholarship opportunities based on their exam performance, making it a valuable addition to any student's academic portfolio.

title: National German Exam
text: The National German Exam offers high school students an unparalleled opportunity to showcase their German language skills and engage in intellectual competition. Administered annually to over 20,000 participants, the Exam empowers students with valuable diagnostic feedback, fostering their progress in language learning. Outstanding performers are recognized through an impressive prize program, instilling a sense of accomplishment and motivation. By providing teachers with comparative data, the Exam aids in curricular development and facilitates the identification of best practices. Participation in the National German Exam empowers students to measure their achievements, develop their German proficiency, and connect with a vibrant community of language enthusiasts.

title: Translators without Borders
text: Translators without Borders offers high school students a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact through their language skills. By joining the organization as a volunteer, students can utilize their language proficiency to support diverse projects, ranging from medical translations to crisis response efforts. Participating in these projects not only allows students to enhance their language abilities but also fosters a sense of global responsibility, cultural understanding, and empathy.

title: TED Translators
text: TED Translators offers high school students the unique opportunity to contribute to a global community while developing valuable language skills. By volunteering as a translator or transcriber, students can make TED Talks accessible to a wider audience, breaking down language barriers and fostering understanding. Participating in this program not only enhances language proficiency but also develops cultural empathy, critical thinking, and a sense of purpose. It is an exceptional opportunity for students to make a meaningful impact while honing their linguistic abilities and expanding their global perspective.

title: Certamen
text: Certamen is a captivating quiz-bowl style competition for high school students studying Latin, Greek, and classical civilizations. By engaging in this game, students have the chance to showcase their comprehension of ancient languages, cultures, and civilizations, as well as their understanding of the enduring impact these topics have on the contemporary world. Participation in Certamen not only fosters a profound understanding of Classics but also sharpens critical thinking, research, and teamwork skills, making it an invaluable asset for students seeking academic excellence and personal growth.

title: US History Bee
text: The US History Bee is a prestigious competition that challenges high school students to delve deeply into American history. By participating, students not only enhance their knowledge of their nation's past but also develop critical thinking, analytical, and problem-solving skills. The competition provides a platform for students to showcase their understanding of historical events, figures, and concepts, fostering a passion for learning and an appreciation for their country's heritage.

title: Citizen Archivist
text: Become a Citizen Archivist and contribute to preserving our country's past while developing valuable skills. Join the National Archives' initiative where students engage in transcribing, tagging, and commenting on historical documents. Through this virtual opportunity, you'll actively support the accessibility and searchability of these records. Participation offers not only a firsthand experience in history but also enhances your research, critical thinking, and communication abilities.

title: By The People Virtual Volunteer
text: By the People is a virtual volunteer opportunity for students to transcribe and review historical documents from the Library of Congress. By participating, students can not only gain valuable experience in history, but also contribute to the preservation and accessibility of American heritage. The program is open to students of all grades and provides a meaningful way to engage with the nation's history while fostering digital literacy skills.

title: Concord Review
text: The Concord Review publishes exemplary history essays from high school students worldwide. With an average word count of 8,500, these research papers display a high level of academic rigor and scholarly writing. Participating in this competition provides students with an opportunity to showcase their research and writing skills, refine their historical analysis abilities, and gain recognition for their work. Published essays are widely distributed to libraries, universities, policymakers, and scholars, increasing students' exposure and potential for further academic pursuits.

title: National History Day
text: National History Day empowers high school students to delve into historical research and present their findings on a subject of their choosing. Participants engage in a comprehensive historical inquiry process, developing valuable skills such as critical thinking, research, and effective communication. The competition offers a platform for students to showcase their historical understanding, creativity, and research abilities, paving the way for academic growth and future success.

title: Medusa Mythology Exam
text: The Medusa Mythology Exam is an annual competition that recognizes high school students for their understanding of Greco-Roman mythology. By showcasing a diverse range of classical themes and underrepresented stories, the exam encourages students to explore ancient narratives and their relevance to the modern world. Participation in the contest provides students with recognition for their academic excellence, fosters a deeper understanding of cultural heritage, and enhances critical thinking skills.

title: George S. & Stella M. Knight Essay Contest
text: High school students are invited to participate in the George S. & Stella M. Knight Essay Contest. The contest encourages students to engage with the American Revolution, Declaration of Independence, and framing of the United States Constitution. Submissions will be judged on historical accuracy, clarity, organization, grammar, spelling, and documentation. This is an opportunity for students to develop their research, writing, and analytical skills while exploring significant historical events and documents. Participation in the contest can also enhance college applications, boost resumes, and foster a deeper understanding of American history and its foundational principles.

title: Michael Kanin Playwriting Awards
text: The Michael Kanin Playwriting Awards program is a prestigious competition that recognizes and supports the talents of high school playwrights. Participation in this competition offers an exceptional opportunity for high school students to refine their writing skills, gain recognition for their work, and engage with a professional theater community. Award recipients receive valuable cash prizes, as well as the chance to participate in workshops, readings, and productions of their plays. By participating in the Michael Kanin Playwriting Awards, students can showcase their creativity, challenge themselves creatively, and contribute to the world of theater.

title: VSA Playwright Discovery Program
text: The VSA Playwright Discovery Program is a unique opportunity for high school students with disabilities to explore their creativity and develop their writing skills. Through this program, students will have the chance to learn about playwriting, collaborate with professional artists, and even have their work produced on stage. Not only is this program a great way for students to learn about the art of playwriting, but it is also a chance for them to build confidence in their abilities and make new friends.

title: Princeton 10-Minute Play Contest
text: A contest from Princeton University for high school students to submit original plays of less than 10 minutes in length to be juried by Princeton University faculty.

title: Young Wildlife Photographer of the Year
text: Young Wildlife Photographer of the Year, sponsored by the Natural History Museum, is an annual competition open to students 17 and younger. Participation offers students a unique opportunity to develop their photography skills, showcase their creativity, and connect with a global community of wildlife enthusiasts. For high school students in particular, the competition provides valuable exposure to the field of photography, encourages them to explore their artistic potential, and fosters an appreciation for the beauty and diversity of the natural world.

title: Jostens Photo Contest
text: Calling all high school photographers! The prestigious Jostens Photo Contest is now accepting submissions. This annual competition offers aspiring photographers the chance to showcase their exceptional skills and potentially win recognition and prizes. With a team of industry experts judging the entries, winners, finalists, and honorable mentions will be celebrated in April. Don't miss out on this incredible opportunity to have your talent evaluated and potentially earn accolades that can boost your portfolio and future photography career.

title: Speak Up, Sing Out! Music Contest
text: The Speak Up, Sing Out! Music Contest invites high school students to use their musical talents to raise awareness about human rights issues and promote social change. This annual contest provides a platform for students to express their creativity, cultivate their social consciousness, develop their songwriting skills, and connect with like-minded individuals who share their passion for justice and equality.

title: Tri-M Music Honor Society
text: Tri-M Music Honor Society recognizes exceptional musical achievements among high school students. Participation offers a platform for collaboration and service within the school community. Members benefit from networking opportunities with fellow musicians, access to scholarship awards, and professional development through masterclasses and workshops. The society encourages leadership and musical growth while fostering a lifelong appreciation for the arts.

title: National Youth Orchestra of the United States of America
text: Join the acclaimed National Youth Orchestra of the United States of America (NYO-USA) and experience a transformative musical journey! This prestigious program provides exceptional high school musicians with the opportunity to train under the guidance of top professional orchestra members, honing their skills and fostering artistic growth. Through a comprehensive audition process and an intensive multi-week residency, participants gain invaluable insights into orchestral repertoire and performance techniques. The culminating tour serves as a dynamic cultural exchange, allowing these young ambassadors to share their passion for music on global stages.

title: American Music Talent Competition
text: High school students worldwide are invited to showcase their musical talents in the American Music Talent Competition. This international competition welcomes solo performers, ensembles, and small orchestras of various instruments, including piano, strings, woodwinds, brass, percussion, and voice. Students can submit video recordings of their performances for consideration, and multiple winners will be selected in each group. Participation in this competition is an excellent opportunity for high school students to gain recognition for their musical abilities, enhance their performance skills, and potentially earn scholarships and other prizes.

title: Lydian String Quartet Commission Prize
text: The Lydian String Quartet proudly seeks creative high school composers to participate in their biennial competition for the commissioning of an original string quartet composition. The winning composer will receive a grand prize of $15,000 to compose a 15-30 minute string quartet for large-scale performance. This is an amazing opportunity for high schoolers to showcase their musical talents while getting their work played by a professional string quartet. Being a part of the composition competition serves as a platform for young composers to gain public recognition and feedback on their artistic abilities.

title: Global Genius Music Competition
text: Aspiring high school musicians can participate in the Global Genius Music Competition, an online platform for classical instrumentalists, vocalists, and traditional musicians of any age or location showcase their talents before a world-class jury of renowned teachers, professors, and industry professionals. By participating not only can you build your network for your personal creative artistic professional development, you can also earn top industry recognition, credibility, and prizes that can provide a boost to one's career in the competitive music world.

title: Lowell Chamber Orchestra Call for Scores
text: High school composers are encouraged to participate in the Lowell Chamber Orchestra's composition competition for a chance to have their work performed by a professional orchestra. The winning composition will be premiered during the 2023-2024 season. In addition to the honor of having their work performed by a professional orchestra, the winning composer will receive a monetary prize and will be featured on the LCO's website and social media.

title: Balsys Young Composers Competition
text: High school students are encouraged to submit their compositions to the 3rd International Eduardas Balsys Young Composers' Competition. The competition offers monetary prizes, and selected finalists will have the opportunity to hear their works performed live by renowned contemporary music performers. Additionally, the final concert will be live-streamed worldwide, providing a platform for showcasing the students' talent and creativity. Participation in the competition offers a valuable experience for aspiring composers, fostering their artistic development and providing recognition for their musical achievements.

title: InterContinental Music Awards
text: High school students can benefit greatly from participating in the InterContinental Music Awards. The awards evaluate music entries from a global and ethical perspective, providing valuable feedback from active industry professionals and Hollywood music executives. Winners receive personalized guidance on succeeding in the music industry, as well as prizes and opportunities for education. Through this competition, students gain recognition for their musical talents, develop industry connections, and enhance their skills.

title: On the Music Waves International Song Contest
text: This international contest gives high school students a unique platform to showcase their passion for music. Participants can gain exposure of their original songs to a renowned panel of judges, potentially boosting their confidence and potential for a career within the music industry. Entry to the contest is open to all musicians regardless of background or experience level, allowing students to experiment within their genre or branch out into new areas.

title: O/Modernt Composition Award
text: High school students are encouraged to participate in the O/Modernt Composition Award for an opportunity to have their work adjudicated by an international jury and potentially performed at prestigious festivals. The competition invites submissions that explore the legacy of Brahms while looking towards the future of music. Participation provides valuable exposure, recognition, and feedback for aspiring young composers.

title: Call for Scores
text: Calling all high school composers! Unleash your musical creativity and submit your original orchestral compositions to the Film Scoring Academy of Europe and the European Recording Orchestra. This prestigious competition offers a life-changing opportunity for two budding composers. Winners will have the unparalleled experience of having their music recorded by the renowned 84-piece European Recording Orchestra at the prestigious Bulgarian National Radio Studio 1. This competition is an exceptional platform to showcase your talents, gain professional recognition, and elevate your musical journey to new heights.

title: Vivaldi Music Competition
text: The Vivaldi International Music Competition is an online music competition for aspiring musicians of all ages and skill levels. By competing, high school students can test their virtuosity and artistry, as well as gain valuable experience performing in front of an international audience. The competition also offers a variety of awards, including cash prizes, scholarships, and performance opportunities, which can help launch young musicians' careers.

title: Zodiac International Music Competition
text: The Zodiac International Music Competition is searching for exceptional musical talents from around the world, and high school students are welcome to participate. This competition provides a platform for young musicians to showcase their skills and creativity through recorded video submissions (or score submissions for composers). Successful participants will have the opportunity to perform on the prestigious Zodiac Music Academy & Festival stage in the South of France and New York. The competition offers a chance for high school students to gain recognition, valuable feedback from renowned musicians, and the potential to launch their musical careers.

title: Mansurian International Competition
text: Aspiring high school composers should consider submitting their work to the Mansurian International Competition. This esteemed competition offers an exceptional platform for young musicians to showcase their talent and potentially win recognition and awards. By participating, students can gain valuable feedback from renowned composers, broaden their musical network, and enhance their portfolio. The competition provides a unique opportunity to receive international exposure and elevate their musical aspirations.

title: Arte Piano Composers Competition
text: The Arte Piano Composers Competition offers a platform for budding composers to showcase their talent on an international stage. High school students can benefit immensely from participating in this prestigious competition. By submitting their original solo piano compositions, they gain valuable experience in the creative process and receive constructive feedback from renowned adjudicators. The opportunity to have their work performed by an esteemed pianist provides recognition and motivation, fostering a deeper passion for music. Additionally, participants stand a chance to win cash prizes, scholarships, and performance opportunities, offering them invaluable support as they pursue their musical aspirations.

title: John Sanders Memorial Competition for Young Composers
text: The John Sanders Memorial Competition for Young Composers provides a unique platform for budding high school composers to showcase their craft. This prestigious international competition encourages the creation of novel liturgical choral works appropriate for cathedral settings. Participating in this competition offers an exceptional chance for young composers to gain recognition and exposure, enhance their compositional skills, and contribute to the enrichment of liturgical music.

title: Lowell Chamber Concerto Competition
text: High school students seeking recognition and performance experience are encouraged to participate in the Lowell Chamber Orchestra's second international concerto competition. Open to musicians of all nationalities born after September 1, 1990, the competition offers a platform for young talent to showcase their virtuosity and artistry. By participating, students gain valuable experience performing with a professional orchestra, receiving feedback from renowned musicians, and potentially winning cash prizes or performance opportunities.

title: Central TX Piano
text: Central TX Piano hosts a virtual competition open to students of all grades. High schoolers specifically will be afforded an opportunity to participate in a competition that helps foster their musical abilities, while receiving recognition for their talent. Participants can select their own piece to perform, allowing for a personalized and meaningful experience. The competition not only provides a platform for students to showcase their skills but also serves as a valuable opportunity to receive feedback from experienced musicians, contributing to their musical growth and development.

title: Radda Rise International Piano Competition
text: The Radda Rise International Piano Competition is a prestigious opportunity for pianists of all ages to showcase their talents and earn valuable feedback from industry professionals. High school students who participate in this competition will have the chance to win cash prizes, custom websites, and personalized feedback from the founder of Radda. Additionally, all applicants will receive custom biographies in English and sessions with the founder of Radda. With no age restrictions and repertoire requirements that include two contrasting solo works for piano, this competition is open to a wide range of pianists. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced performer, the Radda Rise International Piano Competition is an excellent opportunity to develop your skills and pursue your musical aspirations.

title: American Virtuoso International Music Competition
text: Calling high school instrumentalists! The American Virtuoso International Music Competition Winter Edition invites you to showcase your musical prowess. Immerse yourself in masterclasses with esteemed adjudicators and compete for the prestigious Winners Recitals at Carnegie Hall's Weill Recital Hall. The competition seeks musicians with exceptional artistry and stage presence, offering a transformative experience to elevate your musical journey. Don't miss this opportunity to connect with renowned mentors, hone your skills, and perform on one of the world's most celebrated stages.

title: Chicago Violin Competition
text: ChicagoThe Chicago Violin Compettion offers a prestigious stage for aspiring young vilonists aged 7-28. For those in high school, this competition provides an exceptional opportunity to gain recognition, build confidence, and elevate their musical skills on an international scale. Top placers can receive scholarships, cash awards, and the chance to perform at a prestigious venue in Chicago. The competition nurtures young talent, encouraging them to push their musical boundaries and reach new artistic  heights.

title: New York International Piano Competition
text: This prestigious piano competition offers young pianists between 16-22 the chance to showcase their talent on a global stage. Held in New York City, the event provides participants with an invaluable opportunity to gain recognition, win cash prizes, and secure concert appearances. Each contestant will have the opportunity to perform in front of a renowned jury, receive feedback, and connect with professionals in the music industry. The competition fosters musical growth, builds confidence, and exposes young pianists to the highest levels of musicianship. Beyond the awards, it is an exceptional platform for high school students to gain valuable experience, elevate their skills, and ignite their passion for music.

title: The Musical Theater Songwriting Challenge
text: The Musical Theater Songwriting Challenge is a national contest designed to nurture the next generation of songwriters and engage them in the growth of musical theater. High school students with a passion for writing musical theater songs are encouraged to participate in this competition that spans the range of musical styles found in contemporary musicals. The challenge provides an opportunity for aspiring songwriters to showcase their talent, gain feedback from experienced professionals, and contribute to the evolution of musical theater.

title: NextNotes® High School Music Creator Awards
text: Calling all high school composers! The American Composers Forum hosts the NextNotes® High School Music Creator Awards, a transformative competition that sparks creativity and recognizes exceptional musical talent. Participants showcase their original compositions, fostering their artistic development with guidance from professional mentors. Grand-prize winners embark on an unforgettable workshop, attend a concert honoring their work, receive $1,500 in financial support, and gain valuable exposure within the music industry.

title: Boston University Tanglewood Institute
text: Participate in the Boston University Tanglewood Institute's (BUTI) summer program for high school students to become part of a legacy of acclaimed musicians and artists. Receive mentorship from renowned faculty, perform alongside peers, and immerse yourself in the Tanglewood Music Center's vibrant artistic community. Graduates of BUTI join a network of alumni who have gone on to successful careers in music and beyond.

title: VSA International Young Musicians Award Program
text: The VSA International Young Musicians Award Program offers a prestigious platform for high school musicians with disabilities to showcase their exceptional talents. Through this competition, students gain valuable recognition, performance experience on a global stage, and mentorship from esteemed musicians. Participating in the program not only fosters their artistic growth but also empowers them with confidence and a sense of accomplishment, showcasing their abilities and inspiring others to pursue their dreams in music.

title: Lincoln Center Summer Jazz Academy
text: Jazz at Lincoln Center's Summer Jazz Academy offers an unparalleled opportunity for aspiring high school jazz musicians. This selective two-week program features expert faculty, intense training in big bands, personalized private lessons, and unique classes on jazz culture. Students gain invaluable knowledge and skills that foster creativity and enhance their musical abilities. The program culminates in public performances with renowned musicians, providing a platform for aspiring jazz artists and an unforgettable learning experience. It's a transformative journey that propels students toward their musical aspirations.

title: Poetry Out Loud
text: High school students nationwide are encouraged to participate in Poetry Out Loud, a competition that emphasizes the significance and power of spoken verse. It not only enhances public speaking abilities but also instills confidence, deepens understanding of literary heritage, and connects students with contemporary society. Prizes and school stipends totaling over $100,000 are awarded annually, providing students with both recognition and financial support for their educational endeavors.

title: Kenyon Young Writers Workshop
text: The Kenyon Review Young Writers Workshops are transformative experiences for talented high school students passionate about writing. Join a supportive literary community of peers who share your passion, expand your creativity, and discover new writing techniques under the guidance of renowned authors. These workshops offer an unparalleled opportunity to develop your writing skills, receive valuable feedback, and connect with fellow aspiring writers.

title: Adroit Journal Summer Mentorship
text: The Adroit Journal Summer Mentorship Program is a ten-year-old program for high school students that pairs them with established writers for guidance in creative writing. Over the course of the program, students will learn about the creative writing processes of drafting, redrafting, and editing with the assistance of an experienced professional.

title: Leonard L. Milberg ’53 High School Poetry Prize
text: Princeton University's Leonard L. Milberg '53 High School Poetry Prize is an incredible opportunity for 11th grade writers in the US or abroad to showcase their poetic talents. The competition is judged by renowned poets on Princeton's faculty, providing students with invaluable feedback and recognition. By participating, students can gain professional critique, expand their writing abilities, and enhance their college applications.

title: The Patricia Grodd Poetry Prize for Young Writers
text: The Patricia Grodd Poetry Prize offers recognition and rewards for exceptional high school sophomores and junior poets. Entrants have the chance to showcase their writing skills, gain recognition for their work, and connect with a renowned literary community. Participation not only fosters creativity and artistic expression but also provides an opportunity to develop critical thinking and communication skills, which can benefit students in their academic and professional pursuits.

title: Foyle Young Poets Award
text: The Fyle Young Poets Award provides an excellent platform for aspiring poets aged  11-17 to showcase their literary talents. By participating in this competition, high school students can gain recognition for their creative work, receive valuable feedback from professional poets, and connect with a community of young writers. The award has a proven track record of fostering the development of emerging literary voices, offering participants the opportunity to kickstart their writing careers.

title: Young Authors Writing Competition
text: The Young Authors Writing Competition is an esteemed annual international contest for high school writers sponsored by the English and Creative Writing Department at Columbia College Chicago. The competition recognizes talented young writers in the categories of poetry, fiction, and creative nonfiction. Participation in the competition offers prestigious cash prizes, international recognition, and a platform for young writers to showcase their exceptional writing abilities, gain valuable feedback from literary professionals, and connect with a global community of emerging writers.

title: Carl Sandburg Student Poetry Contest
text: High school students can showcase their poetic talents and creativity in the Carl Sandburg Student Poetry Contest. The contest fosters literary expression and recognition, providing a platform for students to share their voices and connect with like-minded peers. Winning poets have the honor of presenting their work at a virtual celebration, receiving recognition for their artistic achievements. Participation in the contest not only enhances writing skills but also promotes self-confidence and a deeper appreciation for poetry.

title: Stella Kupferberg Memorial Short Story
text: The Stella Kupferberg Memorial Short Story Prize provides an exceptional opportunity for high school students to showcase their literary talent and writing prowess. By participating in this prestigious competition, students can gain recognition for their work, receive valuable feedback from renowned judges, and connect with a vibrant community of writers and performers. Moreover, the winning entries will be read aloud by acclaimed actors on the Selected Shorts radio series, fostering national exposure and enhancing the students' literary profiles

title: Nelligan Prize for Short Fiction
text: The Nelligan Prize for Short Fiction offers Colorado high school students the opportunity to showcase their writing skills. The annual competition awards the top short story with recognition and cash prizes. Participation provides students valuable experience in developing their writing abilities, in challenging themselves to create compelling narratives, and in potentially gaining recognition for their literary talents. By submitting their work, students also have the chance to receive feedback from established writers and editors, fostering their growth as young writers.

title: Adroit Prizes
text: Sponsored by the Adroit Journal, high school students can submit up to six poems or three prose works (totaling 3,500 words) for consideration in the Adroit Prizes competition. Winners will be published in the Adroit Journal and receive $500. All submissions are read blind by editors, which is an excellent opportunity for students to receive impartial feedback on their writing.

title: Nancy Thorp Poetry Contest
text: Sponsored by Hollins University, the 59th Annual Nancy Thorp Poetry Contest provides scholarships, cash prizes, and recognition for high school women with a passion for poetry. Open to sophomores and juniors, this competition offers a unique opportunity for budding poets to showcase their talents and potentially earn financial support for their future education.

title: Summer Writing Residency
text: This three-week immersive residency gives high school students an opportunity to work one-on-one with faculty at one of the nation's top writing programs while living on campus. Attend masterclasses, art and writing workshops, evening tours, guest lectures, and participate in daily group discussions designed to challenge you as a writer. Engage with faculty from world-renowned Iowa Writers' Workshop and the Belin-Blank Center's Writing Initiatives Program.

title: SPJ/JEA High School Essay Contest
text: The annual SPJ/JEA essay contest provides a platform for high schoolers to demonstrate their understanding of independent media's crucial role in society. Participation offers valuable benefits: National winners receive scholarship awards recognizing their insights. The competition nurtures critical thinking, writing skills, and an awareness of the importance of a free and independent press.

title: Caterpillar Poetry Prize
text: The Caterpillar Poetry Prize is a chance for aspiring young poets to get their work recognized. Open to all ages 16 and up, the prize is awarded to an unpublished poem written for children between the ages of 7-11. Not only does the winner receive a cash prize of £1000, but their poem will also be published in The Caterpillar magazine and featured on their website. This is an excellent opportunity for high school students to gain recognition for their writing, get their work published, and potentially pursue a career in writing if they so choose.

title: G2 Overachievers
text: High school students have an impressive opportunity to win a cash scholarship through the G2 Overachievers competition. For submissions of 1,000 to 2,500 handwritten words, scholarship recipients can be awarded up to $12,500 to continue their education and or support their community service efforts. Additionally, the school the winner attends can receive up to $2,500 for expenses dedicated to fostering student success.

title: NSPA Awards
text: The National Scholastic Press Association (NSPA) Awards are highly competitive and prestigious recognitions in student journalism across the United States. These awards offer students the chance to showcase their excellence in journalism and compete with the top student media teams and individuals in the nation. Participation in NSPA Awards provides valuable recognition for exceptional work, boosts resumes for college admissions and future career opportunities, and connects students with a community of aspiring journalists.

title:
Claudia Ann Seaman Awards
For Young Writers
text: The Claudia Ann Seaman Awards for Young Writers recognize outstanding high school students in poetry, fiction, and creative nonfiction. Selected by an esteemed panel of published authors, winners receive a $200 cash prize and honorable mentions are also awarded. Submit your best work to potentially earn recognition, financial reward, and feedback from industry professionals, showcasing your writing talents and inspiring your continued literary pursuits.

title: NaNoWriMo Young Writers Program
text: NaNoWriMo Young Writers Program empowers aspiring high school writers to unleash their creativity and develop their writing skills. By participating in this month-long challenge, students get the unique opportunity to draft a complete novel, sharpen their time management abilities, and build a supportive community of fellow writers. This immersive writing experience fosters imagination, perseverance, and a love for storytelling.

title: International Essay Contest for Young People
text: The International Essay Contest for Young People offers high school students a global platform to express their voices and engage with critical issues of our time. Organized by the Goi Peace Foundation, the competition provides a unique opportunity for students to develop their writing skills, research abilities, and critical thinking, while showcasing their perspectives on peace and sustainability. Annual themes vary, offering a chance for students to delve into pressing topics and formulate well-reasoned arguments. Winners receive recognition and cash awards, adding to the contest's appeal.

title: Jane Austin Essay Contest
text: Students in grades 9-12 are invited to participate in the Jane Austen Society of North America's annual Essay Contest. This competition fosters a deep appreciation of Austen's works and encourages critical thinking and writing skills. Winners receive recognition, cash prizes, and the opportunity to publish their essays in the JASNA online journal, "Persuasions." Participation in the contest provides valuable experience for college applications and personal enrichment, fostering a love of literature and the ability to articulate one's own perspectives.

title: Ayn Rand Essay Contests
text: The Ayn Rand Institute holds yearly essay contests granting chances for high school students to win up to $10,000! By submitting their creations to this contest, students open doors for themselves to strengthen and showcase their writing skills, critical thinking, and analytical reasoning capabilities. Participating in such an event not only promotes creativity but also presents opportunities for recognition and financial assistance towards post-secondary education or personal projects.

title: Apprentice Writer
text: Apprentice Writer provides high school students with an exclusive opportunity to have their writing and visual arts featured in a nationally distributed online publication. By participating in this competition, aspiring writers and young artists can showcase their talents and gain recognition. Its virtual platform ensures accessibility for all students, fostering creativity and offering a unique platform to inspire young minds.

title: Teen Ink
text: Teen Ink provides high schoolers a unique opportunity to showcase their creativity and perspectives. Share works and engage in discussion forums contributing to a vibrant community for teenage creatives. By submitting your writings, art and photos, you not only get the chance to be featured in the magazine but also connect with a diverse group of peers who share similar passions. Participating in the competition can boost your confidence, hone your writing skills, and provide valuable experience in self-expression and communication.

title: Fir Acres Workshop
text: Immerse yourself in the world of writing this summer at Fir Acres Workshop! Students will engage in writing workshops led by experienced college-level faculty, deepening their writing skills. Additionally, participants will receive exclusive one-on-one creative writing mentorship from a faculty member, providing invaluable guidance and support. This is an exceptional opportunity for high school students to hone their writing abilities, gain insights from published authors, and receive personalized feedback to enhance their writing potential.

title: Cronkite Summer Journalism Institute
text: Participate in a once-in-a-lifetime media camp experience at the prestigious Cronkite Summer Journalism Institute. Immerse yourself in the world of journalism, guided by esteemed Cronkite faculty and student counselors. This hands-on learning adventure provides high schoolers with unparalleled opportunities to develop their writing skills, explore cutting-edge media technologies, and gain invaluable experience in a professional media environment.

title: Medill Cherubs Program
text: The Medill Cherubs Program is a five-week summer institute for rising high school seniors. Cherubs is designed to provide students with a glimpse into the world of professional journalism and to help them connect with other students who share their passion for journalism. Students will learn from experienced journalists and media professionals, and they will have the opportunity to produce their own journalistic work. The program is highly competitive, but it is a life-changing experience for the students who are selected.

title: Instilt Educate
text: Instill Educate provides free, quality online tutoring to students from underprivileged backgounds. Their mision is to help level the playing field for students who do not have the same access to educational resources as their more advantaged counterparts. By providing access to individualized tutoring, Instill Educate helps students improve their grades, develop stronger study habits, and gain confidence in their academic abilities. In addition, Instill Educate offers a variety of enrichment programs, such as college essay writing and leadership development, to help students prepare for college and beyond.

title: Columbia University 3-Week Summer Immersion
text: The Columbia University Summer Imersion program provides high schoolers with the chance to take an in-depth course on a topic of interest, experience college classes first hand, and mingle with college students. Students can lodge in residential halls on campus or commute from home. Financial assistance is accessible to eligible students, and the application fee can be waved if submitted before February 1st.

title: Teens In Public Service
text: Teens in Public Service (TIPS) offers an exciting summer internship program that empowers high school students to make a meaningful impact in their communities. Through TIPS, teens are matched with charitable organizations and engage in paid community service, fostering their leadership skills, deepening their understanding of civic engagement, and empowering them to drive positive change.

title: National Honor Society
text:
The National Honor Society is a prestigious organization that recognizes exceptional high school students in the United States and its territories. Membership is based on four core qualities: scholarship, leadership, service, and character. 

Students who join the National Honor Society benefit from exclusive opportunities to develop their leadership skills, build a network with like-minded peers, and engage in meaningful service projects that make a positive impact on their communities. Participation also sets them apart in the college admissions process, signifying their commitment to academic excellence and well-rounded development.

title: Paradigm Challenge
text: The Paradigm Challenge is a global competition that challenges students ages 4-18 to use creativity, kindness, and teamwork towards solving real-world issues and making a substantial impact. High school students who participate in this competition stand to gain valuable skills such as problem-solving, critical thinking, and communication. Additionally, they will have the opportunity to showcase their innovative ideas and make meaningful contributions to their communities and the world at large.

title: Stony Brook University - Garcia Center High School Summer Program
text: Immerse yourself in groundbreaking research alongside renowned Garcia faculty and staff at Stony Brook University. The Research Scholar Program for High School Students empowers you to make original contributions, compete in national competitions, publish in respected scientific journals, and present your findings at conferences. It's an exceptional opportunity to ignite your passion for research, cultivate critical thinking skills, and unlock your potential in polymer science and technology. This transformative program fosters a lifelong connection to the world of scientific innovation.

title: LaunchX
text: LaunchX is an entrepreneurship summer program that brings together high school entrepreneurs with the resources and network to unleash their entrepreneurial spirit. The program provides students with access to industry experts, mentors, and investors, as well as a collaborative and supportive environment to develop their business ideas. LaunchX students have the opportunity to learn from experienced entrepreneurs, pitch their ideas to investors, and build connections that can help them launch their own businesses.

title: DNA Day Essay Contest
text: Calling all high school students worldwide! Participate in the prestigious DNA Day Essay Contest and showcase your knowledge of genetics. By deeply examining scientific concepts, crafting well-reasoned arguments, and impressing ASHG members with your essays, you not only have the chance to win cash prizes but also demonstrate your critical thinking, research skills, and writing prowess. This competition provides an exceptional platform for you to explore your passion for genetics and ignite your future scientific endeavors.

title: Engineer Girl Writing Contest
text: Calling all young writers with a passion for engineering! The annual EngineerGirl Writing Contest offers an incredible opportunity for high school students to showcase their creativity and knowledge. By crafting essays, stories, or poems on the captivating topic of engineering and its impact on our world, participants gain valuable STEM skills, boost their writing abilities, and potentially win scholarships or prizes. The contest empowers young minds to explore the fascinating field of engineering, fostering their imagination and encouraging them to envision a future in this transformative profession.

title: Fleet Reserve Association Americanism Essay Contest
text: The Fleet Reserve Association (FRA) hosts an annual essay contest that encourages the exploration of Americanism and patriotism among students in grades 7 through 12. This competition provides a platform for students to develop their critical thinking skills and express their thoughts on the significance of American ideals. Local winners advance to the regional level, and regional winners compete for national prizes. Participation in this contest not only fosters a deeper understanding of American values but also offers recognition and potential scholarships for deserving students.

title: National Leadership Conference
text: The National Leadership Conference (NLC) is a premier 8-day program for high school and college students that aims to cultivate confident leaders who can create positive change in the world. Held annually at Miniwanca in Shelby, Michigan, the NLC provides a transformative experience where participants engage in skill-building workshops, leadership challenges, and collaborative projects that foster personal growth and leadership development. By participating in the NLC, high school students will gain essential skills in communication, critical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making that will empower them to navigate the challenges of college, career, and their personal lives.

title: Key Club
text: Key Club is a high school organization that fosters leadership development and community involvement among its members. Through various service projects, students learn to make a meaningful impact in their communities while honing their leadership skills. Participation in Key Club provides opportunities for personal growth, teamwork, and the acquisition of valuable life skills that can benefit students in their future endeavors.

title: Habitat for Humanity
text: Habitat for Humanity is a nonprofit organization that brings communities together to help families build and improve places to call home. By volunteering with Habitat for Humanity, high school students can make a real difference in their communities while also gaining valuable skills, meeting new people, and making friends. Habitat for Humanity offers a variety of volunteer opportunities for high school students, including building homes, working in the Habitat ReStore, and volunteering at special events.

title: Yale Young Global Scholars
text: Yale Young Global Scholars is an esteemed summer program that fosters critical thinking, leadership, and collaborative learning. Designed for high school students, this program provides an exceptional platform for intellectual growth through engaging lectures, thought-provoking seminars, and immersive experiences that extend beyond the classroom. Participation empowers students with invaluable skills, global perspectives, and potential opportunities for future academic and professional endeavors.

title: Rise Talent Program
text: Rise empowers global change agents and problem solvers of tomorrow by identifying, training, and connecting exceptional high school students from around the world. Through a competitive application process, successful applicants are inducted into the Rise Talent Program, which provides participants with tailored leadership development, mentorship, global networking, project-based learning, and community engagement opportunities. Participation in the program fosters personal growth, global awareness, and the development of essential leadership skills, preparing students to make significant contributions to addressing the world's most pressing challenges.

title: University of Iowa - Secondary Student Training Program (SSTP)
text: The Secondary Student Training Program (SSTP) is an immersive summer research program designed for academically advanced high school students in grades 10-11. This highly selective program offers exceptional opportunities for students to delve into cutting-edge research under the guidance of distinguished University of Iowa faculty. Through hands-on research, engaging classes, and stimulating events, SSTP participants enhance their academic skills, explore their interests, and forge connections with peers and mentors who share their intellectual curiosity. By participating in this transformative program, students gain invaluable experience that can shape their academic and professional aspirations.

title: Center for Unsung Heroes Discovery Award
text: The Milken Center for Unsung Award competition empowers high school students to delve into their creativity and unlock their research potential. Through this experience, students exhume primary sources and craft remarkable projects that highlight unsung heroes who have inspired and acted as catalysts for change. This competition offers a platform for students to cultivate their critical thinking, communication, and leadership skills, while fostering a deep appreciation for the impact of unsung individuals throughout history.

title: Brown Pre-College Programs
text: Brown Pre-College Programs offer high school students a chance to get a taste of college life without the pressure of formal grades. You'll enjoy the excitement and responsibility that comes from balancing challenging academics and enriching social activities. These programs are designed to help you explore the challenges and opportunities of the college experience, and they're a great way to get a head start on your college preparation.

title: President's Environmental Youth Award
text: The President's Environmental Youth Award (PEYA) is a prestigious national award that recognizes outstanding environmental stewardship projects developed by K-12 youth, including high school students. Participation in the PEYA competition provides high school students with an exceptional opportunity to showcase their environmental leadership and passion for protecting our planet. Winners receive national recognition, cash awards, and mentorship from EPA professionals, empowering them to continue their environmental advocacy and potentially pursue careers in environmental fields while encouraging them to be positive role models for younger generations.

title: Lifesmarts Competition
text: Lifesmarts is a national competition that challenges high school students to demonstrate their knowledge of topics such as consumer education, health and safety, personal finance, and environmental science. Through hands-on activities, interactive games, and challenging exams, teams compete at regional qualifiers with the top teams advancing to the national competition. Participation in Lifesmarts prepares students for real-world decision-making, critical thinking, and problem-solving, and provides opportunities to connect with peers and engage with community organizations.

title: American Foreign Service National High School Essay Contest
text: Calling all high school students with a passion for international affairs! The American Foreign Service National High School Essay Contest is your chance to explore a career in diplomacy. By crafting an essay that addresses a pressing global issue and proposing a comprehensive solution, you can showcase your analytical, writing, and problem-solving skills. Not only will you gain invaluable experience and recognition, but you'll also receive the opportunity to attend prestigious events and connect with professionals in the field. Seize this opportunity to make your voice heard and take your first step towards shaping a better future.

title: Amnesty Decoders
text: Amnesty Decoders enlists volunteers to utilize their computers and phones to investigate images, records, and data to expose instances of humans rights violations. Through participation in Amnesty Decoders, high school students gain valuable experience in community service, contribute to important causes, and develop critical thinking and analytical skills.

title: Missing Maps
text: MissingMap is a humanitarian mapping initiative that empowers individuals to contribute to a more equitable world by mapping vulnerable areas where disaster response is challenging. High school students who participate in MissingMap gain valuable skills in geography, critical thinking, and community engagement. By joining this global network of mappers, students make a tangible difference in improving disaster preparedness and response, helping to save lives and protect communities at risk.

title: Best Buddies
text: Best Buddies matches volunteers with individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities for one-on-one email friendships. By joining the e-Buddies program, high school students can make a meaningful impact on the life of their buddy while developing essential communication and empathy skills. Particiating in e-Buddies provides invaluable opportunities for personal growth, fostering inclusivity, and demonstrating a commitment to community service.

title: Be My Eyes
text: Calling all high school students interested in community service hours! Be My Eyes is an incredible online platform that allows you to assist the visually impaired from the comfort of your home. Through a video app, you can provide real-time visual guidance to individuals with vision impairments. Not only will you earn valuable service hours, but you'll also make a tangible difference in the lives of those you assist. Join Be My Eyes today and become a beacon of support for the blind and low-vision community.

title: United Nations Volunteers
text: Join the United Nations Volunteers program to make a meaningful impact on global issues. As a high school student, you can contribute your skills and passion to support UN initiatives worldwide. Create your profile in the UNV Global Talent Pool to access exclusive volunteer opportunities, including virtual and community-based assignments. By participating, you not only gain valuable experience but also make a difference in the lives of others. Explore the website to find the perfect fit and embark on a rewarding journey with United Nations Volunteers.

title: Notre Dame Leadership Seminars
text: Attend the Notre Dame Leadership Seminars, an all paid, college-credit granting program that develops leadership skills, critical thinking, and analytical abilities in high school juniors. Through vibrant discussions and idea exchanges, students explore the global community and hone their leadership capacities.

title: Washington University in St. Louis High School Scholars Program
text: Washington University in St. Louis' High School Scholars Program empowers students with the exceptional opportunity to immerse themselves in rigorous academic pursuits alongside exceptional undergraduates. By enrolling in introductory courses across diverse disciplines, students gain invaluable college-level knowledge and engage in thought-provoking discussions. Through this immersive experience, high schoolers enhance their critical thinking, communication skills, and understanding of various subject matters, preparing them for the rigors of future academic endeavors.

title: Schoolnova
text: SchoolNova offers a weekend academic enrichment program for students ages 3-17 to delve deeper into math, science, languages, and visual arts. For high school students in particular, the program provides an exceptional opportunity to engage with expert instructors on SUNY Stony Brook's campus. This unique learning environment fosters intellectual growth, enhances critical thinking skills, and prepares students for success in higher education and beyond.

title: Gloria Barron Prize for Young Heroes
text: The Gloria Barron Prize is a national honor that celebrates the accomplishments of young leaders in North America. High school students who participate in this competition have the opportunity to showcase their commitment to making a difference in the world. By submitting projects that demonstrate their leadership, initiative, and creativity, students can earn recognition for their hard work and inspire others to follow in their footsteps. In addition to the prestigious award, winners receive a cash prize and media exposure, providing them with valuable resources to further their humanitarian efforts.

title: National High School Ethics Bowl
text: Engage in compelling discussions and develop your ethical reasoning skills at the National High School Ethics Bowl! This prestigious competition provides a unique platform for students to collaborate with peers, delving into real-life ethical dilemmas that shape today's world. Through thought-provoking debates, participants cultivate their ability to think critically, communicate effectively, and empathize with diverse perspectives. The Ethics Bowl enriches students' understanding of moral issues, fostering responsible citizenship and preparing them to make informed decisions in an increasingly complex society.

title: MyImpact Challenge
text: High school students have the chance to make a difference in their communities and win up to $10,000 in the MyImpact Challenge. This civic engagement contest, hosted by the Bill of Rights Institute, encourages students to develop and implement service projects that address real-world issues. All projects meeting entry guidelines receive a digital Civic Achievement badge, and a total of $40,000 in prizes is available to students and teachers. By participating, students can not only make a positive impact on their communities but also develop valuable leadership and civic engagement skills.

title: Youth Service America: Everyday Young Heroes Award
text: The Everyday Young Heroes Award hosted by Youth Service America offers high school students a rewarding opportunity to showcase their dedication to serving their communities and advancing the United Nations' Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Honorees receive recognition for their contributions to society and the opportunity to inspire others to make a positive difference. Participating in this competition allows students to develop leadership, problem-solving, and teamwork skills, while gaining a deeper understanding of their role in creating a more sustainable and equitable world.

title: West Point Summer Leaders Experience
text: The West Point Summer Leaders Program (2023) is a competitive, fully immersive, in-person program designed for high school students who seek to develop their leadership skills. Through the instruction of West Point Cadets, you will experience the rigors of the cadet lifestyle, team-based military training, and engaging physical activities. This powerful program focuses on building crucial teamwork and problem-solving skills through experience-based learning and mentorship. Participation in this program can enhance your college applications and bolster your resume for future endeavors. Spaces are limited, and the application deadline is rapidly approaching.

title: School on Wheels
text: Join School on Wheels, a virtual teaching program that connects high school students with individualized online tutoring support. As a tutor, you'll make a meaningful impact on students' academic journeys while honing your own critical thinking, communication, and teamwork skills. Flexible scheduling and remote access allow you to participate from anywhere with an internet connection. The program fosters a sense of community and provides a unique opportunity for personal and professional growth while supporting the academic success of underserved students.

title: Stanford Compression Forum Summer Internship
text: Stanford Forum's Summer Internship provides high school and early community college students an unmatched opportunity to engage in cutting-edge research that transcends traditional disciplinary boundaries. By participating in this program, students will benefit from hands-on experience in projects guided by experts in various fields. This internship fosters creativity, ignites passions, and offers invaluable exposure to the world of academia while expanding knowledge and skills. Additionally, it provides a platform for students to collaborate with peers and professionals, laying the groundwork for future academic and career endeavors.

title: Udemy
text: Udemy is an online learning platform offering a wide range of courses for those in high school and beyond. The courses are taught by experts in their field and cover a diverse array of subjects, including academic topics, career skills, and personal development. With video lessons, downloadable resources, and interactive quizzes, Udemy provides students with a flexible and engaging learning experience. By participating in Udemy courses, high school students can expand their knowledge, enhance their skills, and prepare for future success in college and beyond.

title: Project Uplift
text: Project Uplift is a summer enrichment and college access program that provides rising high school seniors with the opportunity to experience college life. Participants engage with faculty, staff, and current students, and participate in educational, cultural, and social activities. The program aims to promote and increase access to higher education, particularly for students who are underrepresented in postsecondary education.

title: Quizbowl
text: Quizbowl is a competitive academic activity in which students demonstrate their knowledge of various subjects. Participation in quizbowl offers numerous benefits for high school students. It enhances their academic skills, critical thinking, logic, and problem-solving abilities. Quizbowl also promotes teamwork, communication, and research skills. Furthermore, by exposing students to a wide range of academic disciplines, it helps them develop a comprehensive knowledge base and fosters a lifelong love of learning.

title: United States Academic Decathlon
text: The United States Academic Decathlon® is a commendable scholastic competition for high school students of various academic levels. It fosters a team-based environment, encouraging students to delve into various disciplines, including science, art, economics, and literature. Participation in this competition not only enhances students' knowledge but also teaches them critical thinking, analytical reasoning, and teamwork. Success in the competition brings recognition and potential scholarships.

title: Global Innovation Challenge
text: The Global Innovation Challenge is an annual competition that provides a platform for K-12 student to present innovative ideas, apps, and prototypes on a global stage. The competition fosters critical thinking, problem-solving skills, and creativity in young minds. By showcasing their work to esteemed judges and industry leaders, high school students gain valuable exposure, recognition, and the opportunity to connect with potential mentors and future collaborators.

title: Duke Pre-College Programs
text: Duke Pre-College Programs provide motivated current 6th-11th grade students with experiential learning and academic experiences in a university setting. Building on the legacy programs such as Duke Youth Programs and the Duke Talent Identification Program (TIP), Duke Pre-College Programs inspire and challenge the next generation of thinkers and leaders while offering them a glimpse into the opportunities for their future. Our diverse courses are tailored to the interests and questions top of mind for today’s students while delivering the Duke experience through interactions with Duke faculty, researchers and guest speakers, who are experts in their fields.

title: Prudential Spirit of Community Awards
text: The Prudential Spirit of Community Awards' Emerging Visionaries program empowers high school students (ages 14-18) to create innovative solutions addressing financial and societal challenges in their communities and beyond. By showcasing these Changemakers, the program provides a platform for their ideas, fosters their leadership skills, connects them with potential collaborators, and offers opportunities for funding and mentorship.

title: Smithsonian Digital Volunteers
text: Engage in cutting-edge digital research and contribute to preserving history with Smithsonian Digital Volunteers. Expand access to the Smithsonian's vast collections and gain valuable experience in a variety of scientific and historical fields. This opportunity fosters intellectual curiosity, teamwork, and critical thinking, enriching your high school experience and preparing you for higher education and beyond.

title: EcoLearners New York
text: EcoLearners New York, a chapter of EcoLearning Together, invites high school students to join their cause of spreading climate awareness and education in New York City. As part of an established non-profit and UN partner engaged in restoration efforts worldwide, EcoLearners offers the opportunity for students to participate in events, engage in research, and contribute to virtual platforms promoting climate education. By joining EcoLearners New York, students can make a tangible impact on addressing climate change while developing valuable leadership skills and expanding their knowledge in the field of environmental sustainability.

title: Coursera
text: Coursera, a renowned online learning platform, empowers high school students with access to top-tier university courses from esteemed institutions like Yale, Duke, and UIUC. Through its comprehensive offerings in diverse fields, including Data Science, Computer Science, and Business, Coursera provides students with a transformative opportunity to enhance their knowledge and skills. By engaging in Coursera's courses, students can gain a competitive edge in their academic and future professional endeavors. The platform's flexibility allows for self-paced learning, enabling students to supplement their current education or pursue their own interests. With Coursera, high school students have the chance to explore new subjects, expand their intellectual horizons, and prepare themselves for success in higher education and beyond.

title: Stanford Pre-Collegiate Studies
text: Stanford Pre-Collegiate Studies offers programs that allow high school students to explore advanced subjects, challenge themselves academically, and develop their intellectual and personal growth. Through these programs, students can access Stanford University's world-class resources and engage with cutting-edge topics in a supportive and stimulating environment. Participation in these programs not only provides students with valuable academic experiences but also helps them prepare for future success in higher education and professional careers.

title: William & Mary Summer Academic Sessions
text: Study at William & Mary over the summer and immerse yourself in a vibrant academic environment. Choose from 180 courses in diverse subjects, offered both in person and virtually. Engage with dedicated faculty in small, interactive classes, fostering deeper learning and stronger connections. Summer courses provide an excellent opportunity to accelerate your degree progress, explore new interests, or enhance your research skills - all while enjoying the convenience of a flexible schedule.

title: Leadership Enterprise for a Diverse America (LEDA)
text: The Leadership Enterprise for a Diverse America (LEDA) Scholars Program is a highly selective, national program that empowers exceptional high school juniors from diverse backgrounds to pursue leadership roles in higher education and beyond. Accepted students participate in a rigorous five-week Summer Institute at Princeton University, where they engage in interdisciplinary coursework, leadership development, and community engagement. Throughout their college careers and beyond, LEDA Scholars receive ongoing mentorship, academic support, and professional development opportunities, fostering their growth as leaders who can make a positive impact on their communities and the world.

title: Foresight Prep Summer Leadership Institute
text: Foresight Summer Institute is a life-changing opportunity that will give ambitious high school students the tools and experience to make a real difference. This immersive, three-week program will empower you with the knowledge about some of the most important issues that the world faces today. You'll learn from inspiring experts and work with peers to develop solutions that have the potential to create positive change. Afterward, you'll join a network of fellow activists, change-agents, and community leaders who will support you as you continue your journey making a positive impact on society and the environment.

title: C-SPAN StudentCam Documentary Competition
text: The StudentCam competition is an annual event where high school students have an opportunity to create documentaries that show critical thinking and the ability to address real issues affecting their local communities and the nation as a whole. Winners can earn cash prizes out of a total prize pool of $100,000 that is awarded to the top 150 student documentaries and the 50 teacher advisers who helped guide them. The top spots get the added honor of having their documentaries air on the C-SPAN networks during the month of April, and the top three spots are awarded grand, first and second prizes.
